headings_and_metrics.usage: FPS counters, Tally UMD (Under Monitor Display) labels, Grid preset numbers

body_and_ui.usage: Sidebar lists, toolbar text, system status, metadata

visual_enhancers.canvas_background: Dot pattern grid (bg-[radial-gradient(#262626_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:20px_20px]) to suggest a drag-and-drop workspace.
visual_enhancers.tally_borders: 2px to 4px solid borders around video tiles that glow using drop-shadow when active (Program/Preview).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid heavy glass on video layers to prevent distortion. Use subtle backdrop-blur-md ONLY on the floating top toolbar or modal overlays. NEVER use complete transparent background.
visual_enhancers.led_indicators: Small circular glowing dots inside tiles for signal status (Green/Red/Amber). Use animate-pulse for lost signals (Amber).

layout_canvas.description: Free-form drag & drop area. Should visually look like a dark command center grid.

video_tile.description: Resizable container for NDI stream. Minimal chrome.
video_tile.classes: group relative bg-black rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border/50 hover:border-border transition-colors

umd_label.description: Under Monitor Display label. Floats at the bottom or top of the video tile.
umd_label.classes: absolute bottom-2 left-2 right-2 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-2 rounded-md flex justify-between items-center border border-white/10

sidebar.classes: w-72 bg-[#121212] border-r border-[#262626] h-full flex flex-col

toolbar.classes: h-14 bg-[#0A0A0A]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#262626] flex items-center px-4 justify-between

layouts.structure: App uses a full-screen layout: collapsible sidebar on left, fixed toolbar on top, and a free-form absolute-positioned canvas taking up the remaining space.
layouts.grid_presets: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 buttons should instantly map absolute positions to create uniform grids within the canvas space.
layouts.spacing: Dense layout. Use gap-2 or gap-4 for UI panels. Optical alignment over geometrical alignment for buttons.

motion.tally_switch: Instant color change (0ms transition) for broadcast accuracy. Do not animate tally lights.
motion.ui_interactions: Subtle 150ms ease-in-out for sidebar hover states and buttons.
motion.drag_drop: Tiles should have a slight scale-up (scale-102) and elevated shadow (shadow-2xl) while dragging.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure UMD text (Source Name, FPS) has APCA contrast over 60 against black backgrounds. Hover states must be explicit.
accessibility.test_ids: Include data-testid='ndi-source-item', data-testid='video-tile', data-testid='tally-indicator', data-testid='grid-preset', data-testid='canvas-area'

general_ui_ux_guidelines.instruction: This is a broadcast control interface. It must prioritize legibility in dark rooms, operational safety, and clear status visibility. Treat it as 'Tactical Minimalism'.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.DO_NOT: Do not use pure transparent backgrounds for any text containers. Do not center-align lists. Do not use soft pastel colors. Do not use AI emojis for icons. Do not apply universal transition:all.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark theme exclusively, avoiding standard SaaS blue.
Use standard HTML5 drag and drop or a library like react-rnd for the free-layout canvas, ensuring tiles are resizable.
Mock the NDI video feeds using placeholder solid colors or static image/video urls if real NDI stream is absent.
Ensure video tiles use absolute positioning for free-layout, with bounds restricted to the canvas.
Use Shadcn UI for sidebar, toolbar, and dialogs. Avoid generic Shadcn Cards for video tiles; use raw HTML/Tailwind for maximum flexibility.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
